content.title: Informatica Migration Strategy & Approach
content.content:
SnapLogic was founded by Gaurav Dhillon, who previously co-founded Informatica. The company has deep institutional knowledge of Informatica PowerCenter architecture and has completed 50+ Informatica-to-SnapLogic migration projects. SnapLogic provides **automated conversion tools** and proven methodologies for transitioning from Informatica to SnapLogic.

**Migration Approach:**

**Phase 1: Discovery & Assessment**
- Export Informatica mappings and workflows from PowerCenter Repository as XML
- Analyse mapping complexity: transformation count, custom code (Java/SQL transformlets), reusable components
- Identify high-value candidates for pilot conversion: representative complexity, business-critical, frequent execution

**Phase 2: Automated Conversion**
- Run SnapLogic's Informatica Migration Tool against exported XML
- Tool generates SnapLogic pipelines with equivalent Snaps and transformation logic
- Typical conversion success rate: 70-80% automated, 20-30% manual refinement required

**Phase 3: Manual Refinement & Optimization**
- Review auto-converted pipelines for correctness and optimisation opportunities
- Replace custom SQL transformlets with native SnapLogic Snaps where applicable
- Optimise for streaming execution (SnapLogic processes data as streams rather than in-memory datasets)

**Phase 4: Validation & UAT**
- Execute converted pipelines in test environment against representative data
- Compare output against Informatica baseline for data correctness
- Performance testing: validate throughput and latency meet or exceed Informatica benchmarks

**Phase 5: Cutover & Hypercare**
- Production deployment of converted pipelines
- Parallel run period (SnapLogic and Informatica execute simultaneously for validation)
- Informatica decommissioning after {{customer_name}} sign-off
- Hypercare period with SnapLogic PS on-site or remote support
